The REST module calls `OrderService.getOrderTypes` from two production classes. The calls are in `OrderTypeResource1_10` and `OrderableResource1_10`. I found these with a single regex search for `getOrderTypes(` in the module. I didn't open the files, so I haven't checked the surrounding code.

- **`OrderTypeResource1_10.java`, line 122:** `doGetAll` builds a paged result from `getOrderTypes(context.getIncludeAll())`.
- **`OrderTypeResource1_10.java`, line 130:** a second call with the same `getIncludeAll()` argument. It is probably the search/lookup path.
- **`OrderableResource1_10.java`, line 69:** calls `getOrderTypes(false)`. A change in what it returns would affect the orderable results.
- **`OrderTypeController1_10Test.java`, lines 55, 99, 147 and 157:** these tests compare result counts against `getOrderTypes(true)` and `getOrderTypes(false)`, so they would break if the behaviour changed.
